page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-192-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 1512.0 GB of RAM, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of memory per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage configuration. It comes bundled with 24 local NVMe SSDs, providing a total of 90194 GB of high-speed local storage. This massive local storage capacity is directly attached to the instance, eliminating the need for external block storage for primary workloads. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server type.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the z4d-highmem-192-highlssd offers high resource density, combining massive memory capacity with an exceptionally large local NVMe storage footprint on a single physical host class. This hardware profile is designed for data-intensive workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale databases, high-throughput transactional systems, big data analytics, and enterprise-grade data warehousing where low-latency local storage and high memory capacity are critical.
